corpus.methodology: Hand-authored from generic low-voltage MCU, I2C electrical-budget, power-envelope, source-ownership, reference-plane, decoupling-geometry, LED, component-contract, board-rule, and scope invariants. No competitor fixture, output, or annotation was used. Fault and clean controls are transformations of a separately authored CC0 acceptance design.

results.rationale: Adds review metadata only; no electrical or design contract changes.
Adds ownership metadata only.
Changes only the revision identifier.
Rephrases the controller objective without changing its acceptance criteria or connectivity.
Equivalent wording retains local temperature acquisition over the declared I2C bus.
Changes descriptive wording while manufacturing acceptance criteria and constraints remain intact.
Only the net name changes; its ID, intent, endpoints, and UPDI contract remain unchanged.
Adds build-variant metadata only.
Disconnecting R2 pin 1 from 3V3 removes the required SCL pull-up path.
Disconnecting R1 pin 2 from SDA removes the required SDA pull-up path.
TMP102B required SDA pin 6 becomes disconnected from the I2C data net.
The Qwiic connector's required SCL pin becomes disconnected, breaking the external bus contract.
C1 loses its ground connection and can no longer decouple the MCU supply.
Moving C1 to (2,2) places it about 19.8 mm from U1, violating the declared 3 mm local-decoupling intent.
Moving C1 to (40,28) places it about 26.4 mm from U1, violating the declared 3 mm local-decoupling intent.
Moving C2 to (42,28) places it about 17 mm from U2, violating the sensor's 2 mm decoupling limit.
Disconnecting the LED anode opens the status-indicator current path.
Disconnecting R3 from the LED-anode net opens the current-limited indicator path.
R1 at (2,2) is over 40 mm from J1, exceeding the sensor group's 18 mm maximum diameter.
Moving U2 to (3,15) separates it about 28 mm from C2 and 37.5 mm from J1, violating decoupling and sensor-group limits.
J1 at x=12 is 33 mm from the board's right edge, exceeding the allowed 2 mm edge distance.
J2 at x=25 is 25 mm from the left edge, exceeding the allowed 4 mm edge distance.
A 5.6 V domain maximum exceeds the 3.465 V scope and power constraint, the TMP102B's 4.0 V absolute maximum, and the MCU's 5.5 V operating maximum.
Disconnecting TMP102B supply pin 5 leaves a required power pin unpowered.
Adds only a review-note metadata field; circuitry and constraints are unchanged.
Adds only ownership metadata; the design semantics are unchanged.
Changes only the revision identifier and creates no design defect.
Rewords the controller requirement without weakening its declared acceptance contract.
Rewords the temperature requirement while preserving the same I2C sensing intent.
Changes requirement wording only; manufacturing acceptance criteria remain intact.
Renames the UPDI net without changing its endpoints, connectivity, or function.
Adds only build-variant metadata; no electrical or physical contract changes.
Disconnecting R2 pin 1 from 3V3 removes the required SCL pull-up supply connection.
Disconnecting R1 pin 2 from SDA removes the required SDA pull-up connection.
TMP102B SDA pin 6 is required; disconnecting it breaks sensor communication.
Disconnecting J1 pin 4 breaks the required externally exposed I2C SCL connection.
Disconnecting C1 from ground makes the MCU bypass capacitor ineffective and violates its decoupling contract.
Moving C1 to (2,2) places it far from U1 at (17,15), violating the required local 3 mm MCU decoupling intent.
Moving C1 to (40,28) places it far from U1 at (17,15), violating the required local 3 mm MCU decoupling intent.
Moving C2 to (42,28) places it far from U2 at (31,15), violating the required local 2 mm sensor decoupling intent.
Disconnecting the LED anode opens the status-indicator current path.
Disconnecting R3 from the LED-anode net opens the status-indicator current path.
Moving R1 to (2,2) puts it over 40 mm from J1, exceeding the sensor group's 18 mm maximum diameter.
Moving U2 to (3,15) puts it 37.5 mm from J1 and also separates it from C2, violating grouping and local-decoupling intent.
Moving the fixed Qwiic connector from the right edge to x=12 violates its required right-edge accessibility placement.
Moving the fixed UPDI header to x=25 violates its required placement within 4 mm of the left edge.
Allowing 5.6 V exceeds the TMP102B 4.0 V absolute maximum and 3.6 V operating maximum.
Disconnecting required TMP102B supply pin 5 leaves the sensor unpowered.
